docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Rice’s edition of the 144 inscriptions of Śravaṇa Belgola in Mysore, with a long introduction on the Jain history of the south, Chandragupta and Bhadrabāhu (Bangalore, 1889). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Boston Public Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Inscriptions at Sravana Belgola : a chief seat of the Jains · Rice, B. Lewis (Benjamin Lewis), 1837-1927, Archaeological Survey of Mysore · 1889, 552 scanned pages. Published 1889; B. Lewis Rice died 1927; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
